verdict.line: You lose if you let Jax land empowered autos and Counter Strike you at point-blank range; you win if you poke with Parrrley at range and punish his Leap Strike engages.

brief.thesis: Jax's kit — Empower (W), Counter Strike (E), Relentless Assault (R) — is built entirely around close-range auto-attack exchanges, while Gangplank's Parrrley (Q) lets him deal damage from 625 range without ever entering that window. Gangplank in this matchup carries a 53.2% win rate over 293 games with both lane advantage and solo-kill advantage, and Cannon Barrage (R) gives him global zoning pressure Jax has no ranged answer to once it comes online.

theirWindow.when: Jax lands Empower (W) + Leap Strike (Q) combo
theirWindow.what: If you're caught in melee range when his W is up (cooldown as low as 3s at max rank), his bonus-damage auto or dash hits hard — disengage with Q poke instead of trading autos.

yourWindow.when: Jax's Counter Strike (E) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: E ranges from 18s down to 10s at rank 5 — once it's down he has no way to dodge your autos or punish you with the stun-and-damage pulse, so step in and trade freely or land extra Parrrleys.

start.why: Run by 72.1% of Gangplanks here for a reason — the extra sustain and AD let you hold trades against Jax's auto-reliant poke at the 54.4% win rate this start carries.

boots.why: Picked in 49.9% of games at 51.6% win rate — Jax's damage is entirely physical autos, so flat armor reduces both his Empower hits and his R attack-speed strings.

core.why: First item in the 64.7%-win, 20.9%-pick build path — the mana sustain lets you spam Parrrley to zone Jax off minions without running dry.
Second item in the same core path — the execute threshold turns your poke damage into kills once Jax is low from repeated Q harass.
Caps the highest-win-rate path (64.7% over 51 games) — crit scaling on Parrrley lets you out-damage Jax at range through the mid-to-late game.

jax's team snowballs and you need the lifesteal to survive dives rather than pure burst
you need the sustain from lifesteal boots over Plated Steelcaps' raw armor

runes.keystoneWhy: The extra magic DoT stacks with Grog-Soaked Blade's own poison, so every poke trade against Jax deals more damage over the following seconds than he can answer with a single auto.

summoners.why: Run in 90.3% of games at a 54.5% win rate — Ignite converts your ranged poke and solo-kill advantage into actual early kills, and Flash covers you if Jax lands a Leap Strike engage you misjudge.

playing.title: Poke, don't melee trade
playing.detail: Parrrley at 625 range is free damage. Standing in Jax's auto range when his Empower (W, as low as 3s cooldown) is up just feeds him bonus-damage hits.

playing.title: Track his Counter Strike cooldown
playing.detail: Jax's E ranges 18 down to 10 seconds — fight when it's down. Trading autos while it's up means eating a stun and extra damage for free.

playing.title: Fire Raise Morale into his engage
playing.detail: Pop E the moment Jax commits Leap Strike (Q) so your attack damage and movement speed buff is live for the trade that follows, not wasted before he closes distance.

playing.title: Zone with Cannon Barrage from level 6
playing.detail: Jax has no ranged tool to contest R. Use it to deny his jungle dive paths and punish him for overextending on top.

playing.title: Hold Remove Scurvy for his all-in
playing.detail: Save W's cleanse-and-heal for when Jax commits with Relentless Assault (R) stacking attack speed — don't burn it on minor poke.

playing.title: Punish whiffed Leap Strikes
playing.detail: At max rank his Q is down to a 5-second cooldown, so if he dashes in without Counter Strike ready, step up and land a free Parrrley.

playing.title: Extend trades with your poison
playing.detail: Grog-Soaked Blade's DoT keeps ticking after you disengage, so don't back off a trade early — the poison alone can swing an even exchange in your favor.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the matchup reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Bring Scorch if you want to play aggressively. Use [E] the moment Jax uses Leap Strike (Q) to win lane.
